guarantees.claim: For x from 0 to 4, result[x] is assigned state[x] XOR ((~state[ChiIndexX1[x]]) & state[ChiIndexX2[x]])

assumptions.claim: ChiIndexX1[x] and ChiIndexX2[x] for all x (0..4) must be valid indices within the box_t array range (0..4) to avoid out-of-bounds access
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds indexing leads to simulation X-propagation, synthesis latch inference, or incorrect keccak state update

uncertain_points.claim: ChiIndexX1 and ChiIndexX2 are defined elsewhere; must verify they match the standard Keccak chi permutation (x+1 mod 5, x+2 mod 5) for correctness
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect indices would break the Keccak algorithm, weakening hash security or producing wrong outputs
